why: Check: selecting the same background color twice still applies the background styling to the second output; key change names the cache being returned.
Scrollbar thumb/indicator checks exist but never with an element selected, so the early-return regression is not exercised.
Rotation handle checks at 45 degrees but none at non-100% zoom, so wrong handle distance is not exposed.
Grouping checks never verify layer order of the new group versus other elements.
Undo check only covers entering edit mode then undo/redo; no drag/finish a point then undo to expose history not resuming after pointer up.
Drags a multi-element selection and checks spacing; does not start drag on one member of a group where selection is expanded to the group.
Check: collaboration button shown when host supplies the action, absent when it does not.
Offset-parent check only resizes and checks alignment; loading checks do not use nonzero canvas offsets to verify init scroll-to-center.
Only empty-text submit and shape-move checks on text bindings; no check that editing existing bound text keeps the arrow bound.
Grouping check only groups shape and attached text; never adds text to a container already in a group.
Popup checks (hover, close, display on select) never use an offset canvas or verify popup position over the element.
Only checks the control for a single shape with attached text; no empty selection or mixed selection check.
Checks open scenes by suffix and drops, but never verify Save writes back to the opened file or that the handle is remembered.
Check: click inside selected line's bounding rectangle away from stroke; line must not be treated as the hit and underlying element targetable (bbox hit-testing change named).
Checks midpoint controls and collab handle alignment; no overlapping-element z-order check for point handles.
Footer children checks never specify a minified production build, which is the triggering condition.

Drag-duplicate check with deleted object expects deleted content absent, no Alt stated and wrong expectation (deleted elements must be retained); uncertainty notes drag-duplication path now excludes deleted objects.
Checks press H only; no Alt+Shift+H distribute-horizontally check.
API toggle check requests Library twice and force open/close; never switches tabs of an already-open sidebar via the API.
No check in a browser lacking Object.hasOwn; store checks all assume modern browser.
Check types lowercase 'export-image' in the palette and expects the Export image command; exposes case-sensitive matching against capitalized label.
Undo/redo enabled checks use empty history and edits; no enter/exit view mode check of button state.
Check: with elbow arrow selected, Alt-clicking a segment midpoint must not add a point; names elbow arrows excluded from line editor/midpoints.
Checks earlier trail gone after second stroke; does not check trail fades out after pointerup rather than vanishing; update clearing completed trails noted.
Only an uppercase IPHONE handle check; no check with navigator.platform/userAgent undefined and no mention of a startup crash.
Deleting the first assistant reply is checked only for which messages are removed, not that the preview refreshes; preview checks cover chat switching only.
Checks placement clearance and that the first node stays put when a pending group grows, but nothing about pending children staying centered on the parent.
Insertion-order checks add items to a frame with children but never delete an above-frame child first, so the trigger is missing.
Check 'score=0 still returns the record whose score is 0' targets the new falsy-value skip in collection filters, which is the same defect that breaks =false.
